card.name: Editor's bracketed insertions and notes
card.fires_on: The marked word is inside an editorial insertion or aside, such as '[ed.]', 'Editor's note', or a bracketed initials sign-off. It sits at the 'ed' or 'note' point, or right after a bracket or dash.

modes.label: Bracketed ed. tag
modes.description: The 'ed' of an '[ed.]' editorial interjection placed after a sentence.
modes.example: expected to remain in the final draft of the report [<<ed>>. Colorado River Basin Water Supply & Demand

modes.label: Editor's note label
modes.description: The word 'note' in an 'Editor's note' label.
modes.example: Tips to combat food fraud Editor’s<< note>>: For more on fake ingredients in food

modes.label: Initials or dash aside
modes.description: Initials or a word after a dash or bracket that mark an author's or editor's aside.
modes.example: [I have omitted the sections of chapter II. --<<C>>JG]

card.plain: It fires on the small marks that show an editor or author has inserted a comment into the text, such as [ed.] or Editor's note.
